name: Avalon: The Lost Kingdom

features.name: Increasing multipliers
features.description: Free spins wins get a random 2x–7x multiplier that rises.

features.name: Excalibur feature
features.description: Adds extra wilds during free spins.

review:
King Arthur on a 5x3, 20-line grid. Simple base game: the wild fills in lines, and three or more scatters start free spins, which can retrigger.

The free spins are where it gets interesting. Every win is multiplied by a random multiplier from 2x to 7x, and Excalibur can drop in at random to add extra wilds. Get both together and things move fast. High volatility with a 3,812x max, and free spins arrive about once every 153 spins. The catch is the 94.56% RTP – below most modern slots, so it's one to enjoy in demo.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
